route.name: Rattlesnake Point
route.timeBasis: Planning estimate for the 2.48 km out-and-back at roughly 2–3 km/h, rounded to 50–75 minutes. Excludes stops; allow longer for terrain, children, heat or winter conditions.
route.distanceBasis: Tourism Vernon describes an out-and-back but supplies a 1.24 km one-direction LineString from Yellow Gate parking to the viewpoint. Geometry measures about 1.233 km; returning on the same route doubles the listed 1.24 km. This is not the separate Juniper Trail or a Juniper/Crest loop.

twin-bays.name: Twin Bays / Yellow Gate parking
twin-bays.road: Main park access from Kidston Road
twin-bays.description: Start here for the mapped Rattlesnake Point route, or choose the separate Jade and Juniper Bay trails.

cosens-bay.name: Cosens Bay Gate parking
cosens-bay.description: Choose this entrance for the Cosens Bay Trail and beach. It is a different outing; the 2.5 km return estimate above does not apply.
